security_checks.name: cross-school firestore sweep (64 collections x 10 actors x 5 ops)
auth/session guards, deep links, account switch

findings.title: Firebase options for all environments are placeholders; UAT/prod used to start silently
findings.remediation: UAT/prod refuse to start (StartupErrorApp); operator must run flutterfire configure

findings.title: Android release signed with debug key
findings.remediation: key.properties release signing (Gradle warning when absent; not shown in Flutter's filtered output); keystore must be supplied
findings.verification: APK/AAB built; both debug-signed; release blocker

findings.title: Previous account's shell visible/authorised while next account loads
findings.remediation: navigator gated on uid match; router uid check

findings.title: Staff branch selection survived account change
Parents of a school can read published homework/announcements/notices/exams and live timetable of other branches
findings.affected: firestore.rules (homework, announcements, broadcastNotices, examinations, substitutions, timetables)
findings.remediation: parentAccess index + rules by class/section; school-wide announcements preserved; admin 'Refresh parent access' backfill
findings.verification: parent-scope.test.mjs (9), tenant sweep, 14/14 mutants killed; cutover needs approval

findings.title: No CI
findings.verification: YAML valid; every CI command executed locally; 2 CI-breaking defects fixed; runner execution pending

findings.title: No hosting config/security headers
findings.remediation: hosting block with headers and SPA rewrite; CSP not added
findings.verification: hosting emulator: headers, SPA rewrite, no-cache on entry/deep links; domain checks pending

findings.title: Numbering and totals rely on rules, no trusted backend
findings.remediation: architecture + threat model + phased plan in milestone-12a doc; no migration performed
findings.verification: needs approval before any backend cutover

findings.title: Backup/PITR not configurable from repo
findings.remediation: exact PITR/backup/restore commands and verification drill documented

findings.title: No dependency vulnerability scanner for this SDK
findings.verification: 125 Dart packages: 0 advisories; npm: 5 high in test tooling (dev only)

findings.title: Kotlin metadata-version messages in APK build
Firebase options model could not serve web+Android+iOS and setup note would have broken the build
Firebase option files were git-ignored; a clean checkout could not compile
Class/section-targeted announcements readable by families with a child in the same branch
findings.remediation: documented residual; would need per-child query redesign

release_blockers: no Android upload keystore / iOS signing (owner)
no staging run on real Firebase: rules, indexes, OAuth, smoke tests (owner)
parent-access backfill at rules cutover (owner approval)
acceptance of F-FIN-1 rules-only finance for pilot, and F-SEC-4

milestone_12a.note: Remaining blockers are owner/operations actions (Firebase environments, signing, backups, staging run, cutover backfill, finance/F-SEC-4 acceptance).
